name: CaseWebkitLineClamp
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "webkit-line-clamp" (vendor-prefixed). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: -webkit-line-clamp: 2 + -webkit-box-orient: vertical COMPUTED-ENRICHED (extract/computed): unlabeled styled channels minted from computed-style capture of @ds-contracts/conformance@0.1.0 in headless Chromium 151.0.7922.34; overflow channels in the sibling extension file.
